The Challenge

Challenges in Employer of Record

As an Employer of Record, InSync absorbs the administrative weight and regulatory exposure that make payroll and employment hard to run well. These are the pressure points we take off your plate.

ExposureManaged
01
Compliance

Compliance and Regulatory Complexity

Managing and staying up-to-date with ever-changing employment laws, tax regulations, and compliance requirements can be complex and time-consuming for organizations. Failure to comply with these regulations can result in legal and financial consequences.

02
Jurisdictions

Multi-State and International Compliance

If an organization operates across multiple states or has international operations, managing compliance requirements and staying abreast of labor laws, taxation regulations, and employment practices in different jurisdictions can be complex and challenging.

03
Administration

Payroll and Benefits Administration

Handling payroll processing, benefits administration, and tax withholding accurately and efficiently can be challenging, especially when dealing with a large workforce. It requires expertise, resources, and robust systems to ensure timely and accurate payments and compliance with benefit plans.

04
Scale

Scalability and Flexibility

Adapting to changing business needs, seasonal demands, and workforce fluctuations while maintaining compliance and ensuring seamless payroll and benefits administration requires a scalable and flexible staffing solution.

05
Liability

Risk Management and Liability

As an Employer of Record, assuming the employer responsibilities means taking on certain risks and liabilities associated with employment, such as worker classification, employment disputes, and legal claims. Mitigating these risks and ensuring proper risk management practices are in place is crucial.

InSync Solutions

InSync Solutions to Employer of Records

We take on the role of employer so you don’t carry the operating load. Each stage below is handled end-to-end — compliance, onboarding, payroll, benefits, and risk.

S01

Compliance and Legal Obligations

InSync ensures full compliance with local, state, and federal employment laws and regulations. Our experienced team handles tax withholding and reporting, manages all employment-related paperwork, and stays up to date with changing regulations.

S02

Onboarding and Offboarding

InSync streamlines the onboarding process by handling new employee paperwork, background checks, and drug screenings. For offboarding, we manage termination paperwork, exit interviews, and final payments in compliance with legal requirements.

S03

Payroll Administration

InSync manages accurate and timely payroll processing, including wage calculations, tax withholding, deductions, and direct deposit services. We provide detailed payroll reports and handle year-end tax filings.

S04

Benefits Administration

InSync offers comprehensive benefits administration, including enrollment, management, and compliance with employee benefits programs. We administer benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and other employee perks.

S05

Risk Management and Liability

InSync assumes the role of employer of record, taking on legal and financial liabilities associated with employment. We provide comprehensive insurance coverage, including workers’ compensation and general liability.

Our Service

Our White Glove Service

A high-touch program that carries every worker from first contact through offboarding — proven support functions and services that mirror a traditional employment structure, without the burden landing on you.

Professional Payrolling

Professional Payrolling

Employer of Record (EOR) Services

Our high-touch, white-glove service begins with the first contact and continues throughout the worker’s association with the organization. Our expert team takes over and makes the migration process to our system a breeze for both the client and the employees.

Access to Top Talent

Access to Top Talent

As the Employer of Record (EOR) InSync hires the contingent workers you want to engage as our W2 employees and then contracts with your company to provide their skills on a contingent basis. As a nationally recognized SDVOSB, InSync can help in reaching your diversity spend goals.

InSync’s Professional Payrolling solution is a proven program featuring a number of support functions and services similar to traditional employment structure, including:
  • Online contractor pre-screening and customized enrollment services.
  • Automated on-boarding
  • InSync’s health and welfare benefits include both MEC and Qualifying coverage according to requirements of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (PPACA).
Insurances

Extensive business insurances including general and professional liability

  • Automatic pay check deductions for federal, state and local taxes as well as Social Security and Medicare
  • Workers compensation and unemployment insurance coverage
HR Services

Employee relations and Human Resource services

  • Online portal for pay check details and year-end W2
  • Dedicated Program Specialists and Payroll Specialists who provide “white glove” customer service to both our professional contractors and project sponsors
Benefiting You

Benefiting You

  • Complete front and back-office support for hiring and employing client-sourced W2 contingent workers
  • Pre-employment screening / Credentialing (Background, Drug, Credit, etc.)
  • On-boarding & document collection all tailored to our clients’ needs.
  • Health benefits (ACA Compliant)
  • Diversity Spend with SDVOSB Classification
  • Comprehensive Client Reporting
  • Customized Billing Options
  • Federal, State, Local tax administration
  • Issue payroll checks / direct deposits
  • Process garnishments and maintain compliance
  • Issuance of annual W2s
  • Off-boarding
Employee Benefits

Employee Benefits

InSync offers a comprehensive benefits program meets the unique needs of your payrolled professional contractors:
  • Medical, dental, vision coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement plan
  • In-Hospital cash plan
  • Short-term disability
  • Voluntary insurance programs: accident, cancer, critical illness, disability
  • Voluntary life
  • Weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly deposits or paychecks
  • Direct deposit, Pay Card, or paycheck issuance

Managing your contingent workforce is a challenge. You need to reduce cost, increase quality, and flexibility…all at the same time. Our best-in-class Employer of Record and Payrolling Service helps organizations with large contingent labor pools meet this formidable challenge.

InSync has both the technical expertise and advanced technology to meet your needs and reduce your overhead by relieving you of the unproductive burden of payroll.
